text_content: Salesforce Resources and Guides | CCC | Clear Concise Consulting 0 Salesforce Guides and Resources for Real People Free implementation guides, org health assessments, career tools, and data governance resources. Written by a 13x certified Salesforce Architect who started at EDF and teaches at NYU. Take the AI Readiness Scorecard Subscribe for New Guides Featured Series 10-PART SERIES Salesforce for Recruiters 93,000+ LinkedIn impressions · 400+ new followers · 10 free guides Screening guides for every Salesforce Cloud, certification decoder, JD templates, and salary benchmarks. Everything recruiters need to place Salesforce talent correctly. Read the Series LAUNCHING APRIL 1 What Your Salesforce Org Says About Your Company 10 guides · 10 free templates · Org health to AI readiness The 400-object org. Flow spaghetti. Reports nobody trusts. The sharing model nobody designed. 10 problems I find every time someone hires me to fix their Salesforce. Read the Series Browse by Topic All Posts Salesforce Implementation Data Governance AI Governance Career Development Newsletter Block This newsletter signup form needs a storage option. Edit the block and enter a storage location via the Storage tab. Email Address Subscribe Thank you! AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 9/23/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 9/23/26 Placeholder Values Are the Data Quality Problem Nobody Measures Your fields say 100% complete. The data says nothing. "Other," "TBD," and "N/A" pass every validation rule and tell AI exactly as much as a blank. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 9/23/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 9/23/26 Salesforce Duplicate Records: Find and Fix Before AI Scales the Damage Your CRM says 12,000 contacts. You might have 8,000 people. Measure your duplicate exposure in Excel in under an hour, then stop new duplicates at the door. Read More Nonprofit Salesforce Jeremy Carmona 9/13/26 Nonprofit Salesforce Jeremy Carmona 9/13/26 Two open-source tools for NPSP-to-Nonprofit-Cloud migrations Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 8/26/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 8/26/26 What "AI-Ready Data" Actually Means in Salesforce (And How to Measure It) The median data quality score across 30+ Salesforce assessments is 58 out of 100. Here is how to measure yours in two hours with Excel. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 7/28/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 7/28/26 The AI Queries in My Search Console My highest-impression keyword last quarter was never typed by a human. A 90-day Search Console export from my own consultancy site, and what the machine-phrased queries in it mean for how we write. Read More Government Salesforce Jeremy Carmona 7/23/26 Government Salesforce Jeremy Carmona 7/23/26 Salesforce GovCloud Implementation: What Changes Before the First Login GovCloud is not commercial Salesforce with a flag on it. The authorization boundary changes procurement, features, apps, and staffing. Here is the implementation sequence that respects that. Read More Nonprofit Salesforce Jeremy Carmona 7/21/26 Nonprofit Salesforce Jeremy Carmona 7/21/26 Nonprofit Salesforce Data Migration: What the Free Licenses Don't Cover The Power of Us Program gives you ten free licenses. It does not migrate your donor data. Here is the pre-flight process that separates a clean cutover from a six-week cleanup. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 7/2/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 7/2/26 The Data Quality Delusion: Salesforce Data Governance Comes Before AI Anthropic priced its security trade-off and published it. Most Salesforce SOWs never mention one. Clients want an agent that sees everything and exposes nothing, and the consultant who lets both requirements survive discovery owns whatever happens next. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 7/2/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 7/2/26 Salesforce Flow Governance Broke Before the AI Showed Up Anthropic had layered defenses, constant monitoring, and a three-week patch. The outcome still left their hands. Your org has dozens of ungoverned flows and an error inbox nobody reads. Audit the automation layer before an AI agent scales what it finds. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/27/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/27/26 The Six Governance Checkpoints: A Real Engagement, Walked Through Eight weeks of governance. Three weeks of configuration. The eight governance weeks prevented a deployment that would have failed HIPAA later. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/25/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/25/26 Reversibility: The Rollback Plan Nobody Writes Until It's Too Late 12,000 duplicate Account records overnight. The kill switch worked in 90 seconds. Cleanup took nine days. The agent had not tagged its records. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/21/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/21/26 Proportionality: Not Every AI Decision Needs a Committee An AI Ethics Committee took four weeks to approve typo autocorrect. The same committee approved a Tier 3 Agentforce deployment in 30 minutes. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/18/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/18/26 Accountability: Who Picks Up the Phone When the AI Is Wrong Three teams pointed at each other. Nobody was wrong. Everybody was responsible. Nobody was accountable. The fix was a custom object and one job title. Read More Org Health Jeremy Carmona 5/15/26 Org Health Jeremy Carmona 5/15/26 The Fix: A 30-60-90 Day Roadmap for Cleaning Up Your Salesforce Org I've spent 9 posts telling you what's wrong with your Salesforce org. Here's the part I actually care about: it's all fixable. This guide covers the 30-60-90 day framework I use in every org health engagement. Assess first, fix second, govern third. Free roadmap template included Read More Data Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 Data Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 Preparing Your Salesforce Org for AI: A Data Readiness Checklist Turning on Einstein or Agentforce without checking your data is how AI projects fail. This is the readiness audit Salesforce admins should run before activating any AI feature, covering the five categories that determine whether your org is actually ready. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 The Governance Gap: Why Your Org Isn't Ready for Agentforce (and What to Fix First) I assessed an org that deployed Agentforce before running a data quality audit. The agent was surfacing duplicate records to customers. They disabled it after 2 weeks. Implementation cost: $30K. This guide includes an AI readiness assessment covering data quality, duplication, field completeness, and sharing model review. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 Transparency: Writing AI Governance Docs Four Audiences Will Actually Read A board chair, a project manager, a system admin, and an end user walk into an AI policy. Three of them stop reading by paragraph two. Here is the fix. Read More Org Health Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 Org Health Jeremy Carmona 5/14/26 Your Data Migration Was a Crime Scene: What Nobody Tells You About Moving Data into Salesforce A client migrated 70,000 records from their legacy system. They skipped deduplication. They skipped field mapping validation. They skipped UAT. The result: 12,000 duplicate Accounts, 8,000 orphaned Contacts, and a $25,000 cleanup project. This guide includes a 15-point pre-flight checklist. Read More AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/11/26 AI Governance Jeremy Carmona 5/11/26 Human Oversight: The Difference Between AI and Autopilot "Human-in-the-loop" is on every AI vendor pitch deck. Almost none of them define what that means in practice. Here is what it actually requires. Read More Jeremy Carmona 5/6/26 Jeremy Carmona 5/6/26 Data First: The Principle Most Orgs Skip Most Salesforce orgs run AI features on a data quality baseline of 58 out of 100. That is below the threshold for safe advisory work. Here is the 10-metric audit that fixes it. Read More Need help implementing what you've read? CCC provides Salesforce implementation, data governance, and AI governance services for nonprofit, government, healthcare, and enterprise organizations. The same architect who writes these guides builds the systems. Book a Free Consultation Take the AI Readiness Scorecard
